title: GIRDER Arrow marketed as 2026 with an 8.4 kg claim
publisher: XHS public post; publisher authority unverified
notes: A promotional public post markets a purple Arrow as the 2026 model and lists Shimano 105 R7170 electronic shifting, carbon handlebar, wavy-rim carbon wheels, XS/S/M/L sizes, reinforced rear stays and EPS molding, with an 8.4 kg complete-bike claim. Size, pedals, weighing method, T47/UDH identity and price are unstated. A second captured same-day post repeats substantially the same copy; it is not independent corroboration. This may refer to a related or renamed generation, but equivalence to the official NEW 2025 ARROW is unverified. Retain the official exact-page 8.44 kg value and model name; do not convert this rounded promotional number into an owner measurement. Generic strength, handling and noise-prevention wording does not establish measured stiffness or freedom from faults. Captured comments are partial.

reference_claims.claim: A 2025-08-15 promotional post labels an R7170-equipped Arrow as 2026 and states 8.4 kg.
reference_claims.limitations: Publisher authority and exact frame generation unverified; weight basis absent. Near-identical repost is dependent evidence. Not a replacement for the official exact 2025 trim weight.

capture.scope: Validated exact-query detail archive; public text reviewed. Raw posts, account identifiers and media remain local outside Git. No product-image or measured-weight pixel claim is made.
